name: Mochi Arcade 1.1.0
body:
# Mochi Arcade 1.1.0

A safer save system, a second chance in Number Bloom, and less work while four
puzzles are standing still.

- Explain save failures in English and Simplified Chinese. Keep pending progress
  for retry and make exiting with unsaved progress an explicit choice.
- Verify temporary and backup writes; protect unreadable saves from replacement;
  recover damaged fields from a valid backup while preserving valid newer data.
- Undo the last move directly from Number Bloom's full-board result screen,
  restoring the board, score and random state while retaining the earned best.
- Avoid rebuilding stationary canvases in Number Bloom, Tile Trio, Bubble Garden
  and Mochi Hop. Same-seed desktop comparisons were pixel-identical. No phone
  battery or FPS improvement is claimed.

All eight games, original artwork, English/Simplified Chinese, offline play and
approved Bouncy Balls dimensions remain intact. No ads, account, purchases or
network permission are introduced.

## Install or update

Download **MochiArcade.apk** below. Android 7.0/API 24 or later; arm64-v8a and
x86_64. Package `io.github.seiya058904.mochiarcade`, versionName `1.1.0`,
versionCode `2`. Only the VIBRATE permission is requested.

Install over v1.0.0 **without uninstalling** to retain local progress. The APK uses
the same original certificate; an actual in-place upgrade preserved both save
files, eight game rounds/records and settings on the isolated test emulator.
Uninstalling removes app data. New installs, damaged-save recovery and ordinary
uninstall were also tested.

## Verification and limits

- Godot 4.7.2: 19 suites pass, including 48 save/Undo reliability assertions;
  1,500 Tile Trio boards and 2,000 Mochi Hop seeds / 50,000 targets retained.
- Three portrait ratios in both languages: 64 desktop captures reviewed. Four
  idle canvases rebuilt 0 times instead of 180 over matched 180-frame samples;
  GPU draw calls were unchanged. Integrity checks add disk I/O cost.
- These exact signed bytes passed Android 14/API 34 AOSP x86_64 software-emulator
  installation, v1.0.0 upgrade, eight games with three background returns each,
  input/pause/force-stop restore/restart, settings, first audio-loop survival,
  64-ball/12-fruit loads, backup recovery and uninstall. Native screenshots were
  reviewed separately from the automated reports.
- Hosted software-renderer presentation rates are not phone FPS. No physical
  device was available for this version; phone 60/120 Hz, heat, battery and other
  API/device coverage remain unverified. Android 7+ is the declared minimum,
  not a claim that every supported device was tested.
- Background EGL warnings and earlier failed black-frame/emulator-host runs are
  retained in the repository. This passing signed run does not require or expand
  the historical scoped A14 environment exception and is not a driver-fix claim.

APK: **78,471,916 bytes**, non-debuggable, v2/v3 signed, 16 KiB zip/ELF aligned.
SHA-256: `9676db2f517e9c206317bfce045259294e36c5014b294f155db549b81f263320`

Original certificate SHA-256:
`de1458f30ad0f2a758b9c6f3de82c00b608723eaa75de22d3cf853e351f7657b`

Built from `5672e40968f2169dddce72d82460b7a2bfdfa7c9`. Release source/tag
`4f5d7f78159497f6f6d53d06d4acc16685c25c72` has identical runtime, assets and export
configuration; intervening changes contain acceptance tools and evidence only.
See the [iteration audit](https://github.com/seiya058904/mochi-arcade/blob/main/docs/ITERATION_1.1.md)
and [exact signed acceptance run](https://github.com/seiya058904/mochi-arcade/actions/runs/39930890985).
The [final source signed replay](https://github.com/seiya058904/mochi-arcade/actions/runs/39934863776)
also passes and includes reviewed native custom-startup video.

The immutable v1.0.0 tag and assets are preserved.

name: Mochi Arcade v1.0.0
body:
# Mochi Arcade v1.0.0

Eight cozy, fully offline pocket games in one portrait Android app.

## Artifact

- File: `MochiArcade.apk`
- Package: `io.github.seiya058904.mochiarcade`
- Version: 1.0.0 (versionCode 1), min API 24, target SDK 36
- ABIs: arm64-v8a, x86_64
- SHA-256: `8fcc1ebc83cb9cb8e8947a1a33bef9cba9222b9ac775fafdcd7d3d5cd85d473c`
- Signing certificate SHA-256: `de1458f30ad0f2a758b9c6f3de82c00b608723eaa75de22d3cf853e351f7657b`
- Signature: RSA-3072, v2+v3; non-debuggable; only `android.permission.VIBRATE`; zipalign 16 KiB
- Release commit/tag: `v1.0.0` → `2d45caf40d8334c4c9cc1567164db749d983c7ee`; the APK was built from the same working tree before that commit using the existing release identity. The private key never left the owner's machine and was not uploaded to repository secrets.

## Verification

- 18 required Godot suites: PASS on the release working tree, with zero runtime errors.
- Final release-commit CI: 18 suites, development APK build and maximum-pool phase PASS; the Android input smoke stops only at the owner-approved hosted software-rendered black-frame case (Bouncy Balls repeat-2 background return, blank frame `cfc80ccb...`). That run is retained as FAIL, not reported as PASS.
- Signed-byte acceptance on a controlled AOSP API 34 x86_64 AVD (Google AEHD 2.2, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT host GPU, 720x1280):
  - eight games x three background/foreground returns, 101 visible frames, zero blank frames, same PID, pause checkpoint equality, force-stop round restore and zero-score restart;
  - settings persistence, same-signature reinstall preserves the save, launcher icon, edge-target taps and the first background-music loop;
  - maximum pools: Bouncy Balls 64 balls at 55.43 presented FPS (p95 33.251 ms); Jelly Slice 12 fruit at 60.0 FPS (p95 17.243 ms); original save and backup restored exactly.
- Custom startup experience: the Android system splash shows the original bunny icon; the app boot splash is a cream Mochi Arcade image with the bunny and macaron. No Godot default logo, blue icon or default progress bar is shown, and there is no fake percentage or artificial delay. First launch 463 ms, cold start 408 ms, warm start 79 ms on the controlled AVD; screenshots and screen recordings are retained in `docs/evidence/android-api34-final-splash-2026-10-22/`.
- Bounded static security audit: PASS, no known credential-pattern findings.
- Physical phone: the owner reported a hands-on retest with no problems. Device metadata, captures and the on-phone hash were not supplied; this is subjective user evidence, not automated byte-level physical-device acceptance.

## Known limitations and disclosed risks

- The GitHub-hosted Ubuntu + Mesa llvmpipe software-rendered Android emulator intermittently returns a blank frame after a background return (`EGL_BAD_SURFACE`; a new surface cycle recovers the visible pause sheet with the same PID). Final release-commit run 39724258963 failed at `04-bouncy_balls-repeat-2-background-return` with blank-frame SHA-256 `cfc80ccb6c70119363e7e3da3bbb361f4c4c2628e4856bfdce139ea7b8cdf249`. Raw failures and FAIL statuses are retained; no assertion was removed or relaxed, and this failure is not reported as PASS.
- The release owner approved a scoped environment exception for that specific hosted software-rendered black return only: `OWNER_APPROVED_ENVIRONMENT_EXCEPTION` (A14), with the hardware-GPU API 34 signed-byte acceptance above as substitute evidence. No self-hosted GPU runner was added. This is not a PASS and does not show that every software renderer is stable.
- Physical-phone quantitative performance is UNVERIFIED: no phone frame-time, thermal, battery or refresh-rate measurements were supplied. Emulator compositor FPS (55-60) is not phone FPS. Physical-device automated signed-byte acceptance is DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE; the physical-phone result is user-reported only.
- Bouncy Balls keeps the enlarged play-field revision (32 px ball, 4x6 brick wall, 150x46 multiplier gates, 68 px bumpers, paddle unchanged). The other seven games keep their previous designs.

## Install

Android 7.0+ (API 24). Open the APK with Android's package installer. Updates must retain the same package name and release signing identity to preserve app data. The repository is public; this release is published from the same repository without a replacement repo.
